_comment.newThisWave: execute_covenant_review. _comment.stillStageOnly: stage_renewal is declared; there is no execute_renewal to declare. The renewal clone's collateral aggregate has never been re-probed.
rules: `server` is the connector DISPLAY NAME, never a connector id.
Tool names are the UPSTREAM names listTools() returns, not the normalized mcp__…__ segment.
A colon in a tool name is rejected 422 at publish. None of these carry one.
Passing a non-empty capabilities object is a FULL-SET declaration: anything stored but not restated is revoked.
